policy.note: Public-safe QA signal only. A flag does not prove a question is invalid; it identifies answer-length patterns for human review.
policy.strong: correct answer is outside distractor range by >=18 chars and ratio to distractor median >=1.55 or <=0.65
policy.moderate: outside by >=12 chars and ratio >=1.35 or <=0.74
policy.watch: outside by >=8 chars and ratio >=1.25 or <=0.80
